F5.1 Bucket list view with metrics. NEW src/lib/bucket-list.ts: getBucketList(prisma, scope, options) — superadmin/admin see all buckets, viewer scoped via UserBucketAccess.some.userId. Returns BucketSummary[] with id/name/region/description/createdAt/isActive/documentCount (from filtered-relation _count where isDeleted=false) + storageBytes (BigInt via prisma.document.groupBy by:['bucketId'] _sum:{sizeBytes:true}). Sequential find→groupBy (NOT Promise.all) with groupBy scoped to findMany-returned bucketIds — defense-in-depth per code-review HIGH-1 (viewer's request never touches storage aggregates for buckets they can't see, even in server memory). Empty-bucket-set short-circuits the groupBy round-trip. Sort field=name|createdAt uses orderBy; field=documentCount applied in-memory because Prisma cannot orderBy a filtered-relation _count. Status filter: active (default) | inactive | all. Region filter applied to awsRegion. Shared bucketListQuerySchema (Zod) + parseBucketListQuery helper in same module — used by both /api/s3/buckets and /buckets page so filter dropdowns cannot drift from server validation. parseBucketListQuery rejects dir-without-sort (code-review MED-3 — ambiguous UX). Viewer maps Auth0 sub→User.id via prisma.user.findUnique({where:{auth0Id},select:{id}}) — viewer with no provisioned DB row gets 200 + empty list (not 403) so first-login shows empty state not permission error. BigInt storageBytes serialized at response boundary via toJsonSafe (number ≤2^53, string past). Rate-limit 30/30s per sub via @helpucompli/s3-buckets prefix. Empty-sub guard returns 401 before rate-limit (code-review HIGH-2 — sub ?? 'anon' would collapse quota across token-misconfigured requests). Error path returns generic 'Failed to load buckets' — never echoes Prisma engine err.message which can embed DATABASE_URL (F2.2 sec-review M2 carry-forward). Cache-Control: no-store, private.
